status: Conditional research; physical accounting reviewed. Procurement policies and future engineering inputs are not calibrated probabilities.
coverage: High-end cloud accelerator cohort, top-three matched HBM capacity plus an explicit residual memory pool. Global facility scenarios are an external physical envelope, not a complete global processor/packaging supply model.

units.devices: vendor-defined accelerator devices, not necessarily packages
units.HBM: nominal industry GB/EB conventions, applied consistently on both sides
units.logic: good logic silicon area; excludes HBM, interposers and substrate
units.shipment_GW: rated accelerator power associated with annual manufactured equipment flow
units.inventory_GW: rated system IT-equivalent of uninstalled equipment
units.cost_index: millions of ASIC cost units, GPU:ASIC=3:1; not observed dollars
